column1: # cdr and chpwd_recent_dirs against zsh 5.9.2's own copies: each row is a
# line typed into zsh -f -i, after the hook is installed, and what standard
# output held, each newline written ⏎ and nothing at all written
# PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and a HOME of its own; @D and @H stand for the
cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd '@D/sp ace'; cd @D/c; cdr -l; print ---; cat $HOME/.chpwd-recent-dirs
cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd @D/c; cdr 2; pwd; cdr -l
cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd @D/c; cdr; pwd; cdr; pwd
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-default true; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cdr @D/c; pwd; cdr 1; pwd
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-max 2; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd @D/c; cdr -l; cat $HOME/.chpwd-recent-dirs
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-prune parent; cd @D; cd @D/a; cdr -l; print ---; cd @D/b; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-file $HOME/alt; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cat $HOME/alt; ls $HOME
cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd @D/c; cdr 5; print st=$?
chpwd() { chpwd_recent_dirs }; add-zsh-hook -d chpwd chpwd_recent_dirs; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-prune parent; cd @D/x; cd @D/x/y; cd @D/a; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-prune parent; cd @D/x/y; cd @D/x; cdr -l
mkdir -p $HOME/sub\ dir; cd $HOME/sub\ dir; cd @D/a; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-max 0; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cd @D/c; cd @D/x; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-file $HOME/one $HOME/two; print -r -- "\$'@D/x'" > $HOME/two; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cdr -l; print ---; cat $HOME/one; print ---; cat $HOME/two
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-file $HOME/one +; print -r -- "\$'@D/x'" > $HOME/.chpwd-recent-dirs; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cdr -l
zstyle ':chpwd:*' recent-dirs-default true; cd @D/a; cd @D/b; cdr nosuchdir; print st=$?; pwd
